invariants.name: global_backed_dai_nonnegative
invariants.informal: Total Dai issued is at least the unbacked (sin-backed) portion, so net system-backed Dai is always non-negative.

invariants.name: urn_art_bounded_by_ilk_Art
invariants.informal: No single urn's normalised debt can exceed the ilk's aggregate normalised debt, keeping per-urn accounting consistent with the ilk total.

invariants.name: global_debt_covers_ilk_contribution
invariants.informal: Global total Dai (debt) is at least each ilk's fee-adjusted real debt (Art × rate), since debt equals the sum of all ilks' real debt plus vice, all of which are non-negative.

invariants.name: urn_collateralised_at_spot
invariants.informal: After frob, the urn's fee-adjusted real debt (art × rate) does not exceed its collateral value at the safety-margin oracle price (ink × spot).

invariants.name: urn_dust_floor
invariants.informal: A non-empty urn must carry at least the dust-floor amount of real debt, preventing uneconomic micro-positions that cannot be profitably liquidated.

invariants.name: ilk_debt_within_ceiling
invariants.informal: When frob increases an ilk's debt, the ilk's total fee-adjusted real debt (Art × rate) must not exceed the per-ilk debt ceiling.

invariants.name: global_debt_within_ceiling
invariants.informal: When frob increases debt, the global total Dai issued must not exceed the system-wide debt ceiling.

invariants.name: rate_positive_for_ilk
invariants.informal: The ilk's accumulated rate (principal compounded with stability fees) must be non-zero, ensuring fee-adjusted debt is well-defined and every unit of normalised debt maps to a positive real Dai obligation.
